description: Ministry of Public Administration and Management - Revision of the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service Minute published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. Nos. 1670/33 of 10.09.2010, 1695/15 of 01.03.2011 and 1865/36 of 06.06.2014
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with revisions to the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service minute, focusing on public service recruitment, training requirements, promotion criteria, and service conditions for government accountants. It specifies examination requirements, training programs through the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration, promotion rules, and service grade structures - all of which fall under public sector administration and human resource management, making it a Public Service Gazette.
